hypothesis: NTP initialization improves matched full-region neural recovery of fixed additive teachers at equal supervised updates and sample counts.
readout: masked mean of all contextual content and true EOS states, LayerNorm, scalar linear output
initialization: scratch random; pretrained and joint use identical validation-selected NTP checkpoint; paired head initialization
comparison: equal supervised person draws and updates; report NTP initialization cost separately and extra joint FLOPs

training.selection: minimum validation teacher MSE, never test

resources.campaign_execution: first full-context synthetic canary and 100-step A1 screen; continue all three teachers only after finite stable execution; screen seeds and sample-efficiency stages sequentially within reviewed runtime estimates

limitations: Synthetic additive recovery is not clinical prediction or evidence of improvement over the supplied teacher
Only 55 validation people; all adaptive selections and screens are development results
Joint auxiliary NTP sees full-region context, exceeding the 256-token NTP pretraining windows
This recipe lists permitted comparisons; running a subset does not establish the unexecuted comparisons
